title: Holger Hellinger | Director of Experience Engineering
name: Holger Hellinger
meta_description: Director of Experience Engineering and Practice Lead Germany. 25+ years of accessible, scalable digital products, design systems and AI-assisted delivery pipelines.
tldr: I lead Experience Engineering teams and programs across global, distributed delivery. 25+ years in digital products. I build accessible, fast platforms on solid frontend architecture, design systems and pipelines with real quality gates. AI agents are part of my delivery. Humans still sign off merges and check the UI.
summary:
I have built digital products for enterprise clients for more than 25 years. My work connects product, frontend engineering, design systems and delivery.

I lead teams and programs from first direction to rollout. My focus is maintainable architecture, accessibility, performance and product quality that lasts. I pick architecture by need. A monolith for simple apps. Microfrontends when scale or separate team deployments demand it. Legacy platforms I migrate step by step, starting from a spec extracted from the existing code: same in, same out.

Design and engineering are one system for me. Design tokens, design system governance and Figma to code handoff keep both sides in sync. Quality lives in the pipeline: SonarQube, Dynatrace, linting and automated tests. About 70% of device and browser coverage runs as automated e2e tests. The rest is manual accessibility testing with screen readers and braille.

I use AI agents for governance, linting, pipeline checks and PR documentation. Agents scan and comment. Merging stays human. Code gets refreshed with every release as part of daily delivery, not in separate refactoring projects.

experience.description: As Practice Lead Germany, I lead Experience Engineering teams across global delivery and enterprise programs. I set up distributed teams and shape delivery around modular frontend architecture, design systems and pipeline quality gates. I brought accessibility automation into CI/CD and paired it with manual screen reader and braille testing on large WCAG-focused platforms. I introduced AI agents for linting, governance and PR documentation, with human review on every merge. I keep scope realistic: new requirements with real business value come in, lower-value backlog items move out, and teams do not burn out.
Built and shipped frontends for brands such as Daimler, Fleurop and o2. Standards-based, maintainable interfaces built to last.
Delivered web platforms for key client accounts. Turned complex requirements into usable, production-ready frontends.
Led web development for a wide range of clients. Set up early web standards practices for interactive and business products.
